title: IGCSE / O Level Computer Science & ICT Preparation
subject: IGCSE / O Level
description: International secondary academic curriculum covering computational thinking, programming logic, data representation, logic gates, and theory of computer systems.
prerequisites: Secondary school student or adult learner preparing for Cambridge/Edexcel examinations.
target_audience: IGCSE / O Level candidates, High School Students, and Computer Science Beginners.

modules.title: Theory of Computer Systems & Data Representation
lessons: Number Systems: Binary, Denary & Hexadecimal Conversions
Data Representation: Text, Sound & Bitmap Images
Von Neumann Architecture, CPU Registers & Fetch-Execute Cycle

modules.title: Logic Gates & Algorithm Problem Solving
lessons: Logic Gates, Boolean Expressions & Truth Tables

modules.title: Practical Programming & Exam Readiness
lessons: Sequence, Selection & Iteration in Structured Code
IGCSE Past Paper Case Studies & Exam Solving
